name: Rumble Wristside
description: Open with the two edges level and the shoulders square in the formal salute of the pair.

name: Ironscute
description: Hold the blades to either side of the centerline so the guard looks open and is not.

name: Nova Shortedge
description: Thrust with the left and right blades one beat apart so the second finds what the first revealed.

name: Blazepleat
description: Wrap the cut in the xiantian field so the edge keeps its line even through a resisting guard.

name: Hoarfrost Swingguard
description: Bind the answering blade in the crossed edges and hold it while the field presses along both steels.

name: Gust Cheekhilt
description: Take the court's level step across the floor with the field keeping the whole body even.

name: Ironpleat
description: Deliver both edges together on a single point of the target in a cut that rules the exchange.

name: Hiltfold Nerve
description: Raise the field around the blades in an even ring that blunts heavy strikes from any side.

name: Grave Shearedge
description: A single unhurried cut that carries the whole field into the edge and ignores the guard in its way.

name: Hoarfrost Edgepair
description: Settle the weight into the heels and let the blades hang ready like the rim of a still basin.

name: Pleatmettle
description: Stand firm like a river stone and let the parry divide the blow into two streams.

name: Spearing Fliptang
description: Dart the blade forward in a quick narrow current that finds the seam of the armor.

name: Overbearing Shearing
description: Stir the blades in a muddy swirl so the foe cannot tell which hand will strike.

name: Unconquered Doublehilt
description: Pool the field in the crook of the crossed blades until each blow sinks into it.

name: Crossing Scourge
description: When the pooled field is full spill it over the rim of the guard in a single hard cut.

name: Ghosting Platepoint
description: Move in the direction of the foe's own push so the force carries the body past the guard.

name: Unbowed Wristside
description: Hold the pooled field at full and return a share of each blow along the opposing blade.

name: Hourpleat
description: A flurry of cuts and thrusts that follows the foe's retreat like a river after a falling stone.

name: Punishing Blaze Platepoint
description: Gather the pooled field in a long breath then release it as one flood-heavy cut that breaks the foe's stance.

name: Eviscerating Scissor
description: Draw from a high guard with both blades raised and cut as they come down.

name: Scutenerve
description: Hold the crossed blades above the brow so any strike meets steel before it meets the face.

name: Ferocious Doublehilt
description: Fall onto the foe with the lead blade stabbing down along the line of the collarbone.

name: Wingblink
description: Circle the opponent at the edge of reach with short wheeling paces and the blades held high.

name: Murk Hiltfold
description: Sweep the blades upward like a rising current and throw a descending blow back into the air.

name: Gust Snapcut
description: Cover the open gap in one field-driven stoop that ends inside the foe's reach.

name: Strangling Clipper
description: Rip the hooked guard along the foe's blade and tear the weapon out of its line.

name: Chime Shearedge
description: Hold the field wide and still so the smallest shift of the foe's weight reads clearly.

name: Mangling Cheekhilt
description: Gather the field overhead and drive both blades down together on one point of the foe.

name: Phantom Flurry
description: Spring back up from a plunge with the blades already sweeping aside the answering cut.

name: Rumblemoth
description: Vanish upward on a burst of the field and come down behind the guard with both edges falling.

name: Shearing Wrath
description: Draw the blades without a whisper of steel on the scabbard lip and cut on the same breath.

name: Flintlike Edgepair
description: Take a blow on the blade held close to the body so the clash makes almost no sound.

name: Facet Snapcut
description: Place the foot heel first and thrust silently along the line of a sleeping guard.

name: Siltwing
description: Step aside while holding the breath so the field leaves no ripple for a listener to feel.

name: Toxin Crossing
description: Lift the foe's blade with a damped touch that turns the stroke before it is born.

name: Punishing Scissor
description: Both edges close on a target together in a cut so quiet that bystanders miss it.

name: Inexorable Swingguard
description: Wrap the body in a flat still field that swallows the sound and shock of attacks.

name: Rumble Doublehilt
description: Drive a thread of field through the blade to the heart in a stroke that arrives without warning.

name: Reverie Flurry
description: Slip through the opponent's guard as though it were mist and strike from within with both edges.

name: Facet Shearedge
description: Open the arms wide with the blades lowered and invite the opponent's first stroke in the formal manner.

name: Scutewrath
description: Cut along a long clean line that the eye follows like the horizon of a clear sky.

name: Pleathavoc
description: Thrust with both blades along parallel lines so the foe must answer two points at once.

name: Shortedge Slipstream
description: Slide away from a thrust on a long low step like a hawk catching a wind.

name: Chime Shortedge
description: Move the blades in a soft mist of small circles that turns aside the strikes of lesser weapons.

name: Chime Platepoint
description: Spread the xiantian field wide to feel every body moving within a long stride of the blades.

name: Gust Flurry
description: Throw the field out along the blade so the cut lands a full pace beyond the steel.

name: Snapcut Blink
description: Drop to the low guard and glide forward like a swell moving across the floor of a basin.

name: Pleatnerve
description: Hold the foe between two long field lines that run out from the blades like horizons.

name: Flintlike Fliptang
description: Raise a broad arc of the field with both blades that covers the swordsman and a comrade beside him.

name: Devastating Scissor
description: Turn once with the field stretched along both blades and sweep every foe within the long reach.

name: Mayhem Fliptang
description: Spread the whole field outward in the pair's greatest form and cut all that enter it.

name: Facet Wristside
description: Stand so that each blade is placed to cover the other's open side.

name: Devastating Clipper
description: Cut with the lead blade along the body track while the mate stays back in cover.

name: Rumble Crossing
description: Thrust with the mate blade along the qi track the moment the lead cut is parried.

name: Mightwing
description: Take two parallel steps so that the body track and the qi track arrive together.

name: Invincible Swingguard
description: Split the field into two tracks one along each blade so the guard never shares a flaw.

name: Mothhavoc
description: When one blade is turned the mate answers on the second track with a deeper cut.

name: Wingdurance
description: Swap which blade carries the field mid-stroke so the foe guards the wrong edge.

name: Might Shearing
description: Bring both tracks of the field to a single cut that lands where the body track alone could not.

name: Pleatvortex
description: Withdraw while one blade covers the retreat and its mate keeps the field closed.

name: Scutemettle
description: One blade draws in the force of the foe's stroke and the mate sends it back doubled.

name: Titanic Clipper
description: Draw and cut with no flourish since nothing more is needed against a lesser guard.

name: Facet Edgepair
description: Set the stance on the full weight of the meridian network and stand like iron under a blow.

name: Nova Doublehilt
description: Drive the point forward behind a hard elbow so the thrust has the whole body's weight.

name: Fliptang Wrath
description: Surge the full mortal qi into the wrists for a pair of cuts as hard as steel allows.

name: Silt Shearedge
description: Send a pulse along the meridian network and cross the floor in a single burst of speed.

name: Pleatdurance
description: Clamp the foe's blade between wrists tempered by qi and hold it against any strength.

name: Sanguine Shearing
description: A cut of perfect timing that falls on the foe just as the foe's own stroke begins.

name: Scutespine
description: Turn blow after blow aside in a flowing guard with no pause for breath.

name: Rumble Platepoint
description: Push body and qi to their mortal peak in one cut that no weaker guard can survive.

name: Eviscerating Hiltfold
description: Speak the first words of the oath on the draw and cut across the line.

name: Murk Edgepair
description: Turn the blow along the grain of the wind so it runs off the blades without a clash.

name: Novapleat
description: Drive the point forward in a hard narrow thrust that whistles on its way.

name: Wristside Whirlpool
description: Step along the line of the wind so each pace gains speed from the last.

name: Suffocating Snapcut
description: Bind the opposing blade in a spiral of field that tightens as the oath is spoken.

name: Flurryruin
description: Cut from above like a wind falling off the plateau edge onto the foe.

name: Evergreen Shortedge
description: Hold the sworn ground with the field spread low so the feet cannot be swept or moved.

name: Scutescourge
description: Answer the foe's stroke with a gale-swift pair of cuts spoken in one breath.

name: Unbowed Swingguard
description: Wrap the body in a turning wind of qi that bleeds the force from any strike.

name: Novaflurry
description: Cross the distance in a single gale-swift flash and cut with both edges as one voice.

name: Iron Swingguard
description: Stand square on open ground with the blades wide and the knees soft against any rush.

name: Might Flurry
description: Cut in a wide arc that uses the open ground and leaves no place to settle.

name: Pleatflash
description: Walk the line of an edge with steady feet so a push from the side finds nothing to move.

name: Impervious Fliptang
description: Meet the rush without stepping back and turn it aside in a single sworn motion.

name: Scissor Devastation
description: Cut with the wind that blows along the plateau's rim so the edge arrives from the side.

name: Intent Clipper
description: Hold the foe at the length of a blade with the field pressing outward from both guards.

name: Daybreak Cheekhilt
description: Turn on the plateau's rim and sweep the field in a ring that forces all foes back.

name: Adamantine Cheekhilt
description: Hold the line at the edge with both blades while the field takes every blow.

name: Thorn Shortedge
description: Take the full force of a charging foe on the planted guard and release it in a reply cut.

name: Blazewing
description: Cut from the side of the opponent's stance as a crosswind comes from the unwatched direction.

name: Granite Shearedge
description: Anchor the blades to a fixed bearing and let every blow find the same steel.

name: Flurry Wrath
description: Thrust on a slant that follows the wind's angle and slips beneath a lifted guard.

name: Equipoise Edgepair
description: Give with the blow and bend it round the body before springing straight again.

name: Gust Platepoint
description: Drift sideways with the shove of the crosswind and return to the bearing in one step.

name: Flurrynerve
description: Cross the blades through the foe's guard from the side and lock its weapon against its own body.

name: Berserk Scissor
description: Turn the parried force into a gust of field that adds weight to the answering cut.

name: Waning Wristside
description: Hold the bearing and feel through the field which way the push will come next.

name: Sanguine Crossing
description: Cut once with each blade from opposite sides in a crosswind that splits the foe's guard.

name: Impervious Doublehilt
description: Stand on the bearing while the field cancels the push of every strike that lands.

name: Corroding Shearing Reckoning
description: One crosswind cut that carries the field through guard and armor into the body.

name: Pleatvalor
description: Salute with the blades crossed and then part them in a calm bearing against the foe.

name: Blaze Snapcut
description: Count the gusts of the fight and cut with each lull between them.

name: Facetpleat
description: Read the direction of the foe's breath and jab to the side it leaves open.

name: Torrential Crossing
description: Cross the open ground with long even paces that keep the blades lowered and quiet.

name: Webbing Cheekhilt
description: Press the field forward from both blades until the foe's strokes become short and slow.

name: Chimemoth
description: Throw a blow aside on a sworn wind and leave its owner leaning past the swordsman.

name: Tempered Clipper
description: Cut in the last lull before a gust so the foe's guard is down when the blade arrives.

name: Titanic Fliptang
description: Deflect the first blow and cut across the second in one reckoned turn of the wrists.

name: Torrent Snapcut
description: Surge across the plateau on a rising wind and land both blades on the foe's flank.

name: Lightning Cheekhilt Vortex
description: Slip through the foe's guard on the sworn wind and strike as the field closes behind you.

name: Charter Edgepair
description: Face the incoming strikes with feet planted and the blades crossed low like a post.

name: Unbowed Platepoint
description: Shed a blow from the blade as rain runs from a roof and keep the stance.

name: Lancing Swingguard
description: A very short thrust launched from the guard that lands before the foe's recovery.

name: Unseen Shortedge
description: After being pushed off the line return to the bearing in a single step.

name: Thorn Shearedge
description: Add the weight of the wind to the guard so heavy blows lose their force on the steel.

name: Blistering Crossing
description: Cut through the gap between two heavy blows when the storm of strikes pauses for breath.

name: Indomitable Hiltfold
description: Hold the line against sustained assault while the field dissolves each blow into the air.

name: Devastating Doublehilt
description: Break the rhythm of a flurry with one counter that shatters the attacker's balance.

name: Unbowed Hiltfold
description: Take a storm of blows into the field without moving the feet and return it in one cut.

name: Unseen Wristside
description: Walk the plateau rim at the steady pace of a patrol with the blades low and ready.

name: Facet Doublehilt
description: Raise the blades at the end of the spoken oath so the guard is set by the last word.

name: Mothruin
description: Cut upward from a low position like grass springing when a boot is lifted.

name: Facet Shearing
description: Stab through a gap in cover as a patroller does through tall plateau grass.

name: Murk Flurry
description: Kick up a spurt of dust with the lead foot and cut from the other side while the foe blinks.

name: Probing Platepoint
description: Stretch the field along the rim to learn who approaches from a long way across the open ground.

name: Wingspine
description: Catch the opposing blade where the crossing of the guards sits and press it toward the rim.

name: Merciless Shortedge
description: Both edges close on a foe in a short cut meant to stop a runner rather than kill him.

name: Wingflash
description: Step back upwind after a cut and let the wind carry the blades back to guard.

name: Granite Hiltfold
description: Spin with outstretched blades and drive a wide field sweep across all the ground the patrol holds.

name: Hiltfold Hardihood
description: Hold the oath pair in a standing ward that guards a narrow path against any number.

name: Unseen Glint Clipper
description: Flash across the open ground on the wind and sweep both edges through every foe in the path.

name: Tempered Scissor
description: Draw and cut as the plateau wind rises in the lungs with no field to carry it.

name: Aegisscute
description: Brace the guard on a lattice of fully opened meridians until the steel rings but holds.

name: Flurryscourge
description: Narrow the whole body behind the point and thrust like a gust through a slit.

name: Meteoric Shearing
description: Advance on a bearing so true that the foe's guard seems to come to meet the blades.

name: Sanguine Swingguard
description: Surge the whole qi network into both wrists in one rushing cut.

name: Gust Fliptang
description: Hold the guard with the full network of meridians so every parry rings true.

name: Fastening Crossing
description: Lock the foe's arms between the blades in a sudden gust of strength.

name: Ironflurry
description: Answer any stroke with a counter cut timed to a gust that none can follow by eye.

name: Granite Edgepair
description: Hold both blades in a ward powered by the entire mortal network against heavy strikes.

name: Scissor Reckoning
description: Spend the master's whole reserve in a wind-swift pair of cuts that approach the limit of mortal qi.
